title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
一座小村庄的街道上，一名二十岁左右的青年，开着一辆装满货物的电动三轮车行驶着。青年名叫王仙，是村子里为数不多的大学生之一。王仙大学毕业后，就留在上学的那座大城市，有着一份稳定的工作，无论工资还是工作环境，都是极好的。而且，凭借着自己的努力，王仙还在那座大城市买了一套房子，当然，只是首付。工作稳定，还有了房子，再加上王仙本身的相貌和身材都是偏上，在朋友的介绍下，也找到了自己的另一半。如此条件，在村里，王仙的名气自然不低。毕竟在村里，人们没事干闲聊的时候，总是拿出各家的孩子相互比较，而王仙恰恰就是人们口中‘别人家的孩子’。可是，这种事情在一年前变了，王仙不在是众人口中‘别人家的孩子’，而是被众人拿出来教训自己家孩子的典型。这一切都是因为王仙在一年前突然辞掉了大城市的稳定工作，还将自己那套首付的房子低价转卖掉了，甚至还和那漂亮的女朋友分了手。这本来是王仙自己的事，大家也没有说什么，作为同村人，他们只是为王仙感觉到可惜而已。在他们看来，或许是王仙在大城市遇到了什么难事。只是，这种看法随着时间的推移，彻底的变了。他们本来以为王仙会在家里待一段时间后，会重新振作，可是王仙接下来的做法却将所有人惊到了，甚至他们一度怀疑王仙是不是中邪了。整天待在家里无所事事，而且家中会经常传来各种怒吼之声，村里的人都听的出来，这是王仙父亲的声音。就这样持续了近乎十个月后，王仙终于不在无所事事了，而是包了一块地，开了一个养殖场。本来吧，养殖场也没什么，也算一份正常的营生，虽然有些累，有些脏。可是，王仙养殖的不是他们熟悉的家禽或者家畜，而是各种奇奇怪怪的东西，有蟑螂，蚯蚓，蝗虫，蝎子，蜈蚣等等。最让村里人无法接受的是，王仙的养殖场中，还养了一大批的老鼠。没错，就是老鼠，农村人最恨的存在之一。好吧，养什么都是王仙自己的事，哪怕是老鼠，村里人虽然有意见，但也只是背后说说而已，毕竟王仙的养殖场封锁做的很好，几个月过去了，从来没有老鼠或者其它奇怪的东西从养殖场逃出去过，更重要是养殖场离村庄的距离不算近。不过，养殖归养殖，村里的人却没有看到王仙有任何的受益。不仅如此，而且还将他父亲在城里买的房子给卖了，全部用来买那些东西吃的饲料了，据说还因此将他父亲给气病了。王仙开着装满货物的三轮车，穿过村庄，行驶了五六分后，来了一座四周都是三米左右高墙，只有一道铁门的建筑前。此刻，铁门前，站着两个中年人。看到这两人，王仙的脸色微微一变。“村长，书记，您两老人家怎么来了？”王仙下车，麻利的掏出一盒烟，向着两人递去。“别整这一出，你小子上个月怎么跟我保证的？你养那些蟑螂，蚯蚓，蜈蚣，蝎子之类的，我也不说什么，毕竟那些个玩意算药材，可你怎么就养了那么多老鼠啊？这破玩意是能随便养的么？闹出鼠疫来怎么办？”村长一脸怒色的看着王仙，语气之中还有种恨铁不成钢的意思。

当初王仙考上大学生，还是重点大学，得到了镇里的奖励，让他在十里八村的长够了脸，可是这小子如今居然把大城市的工作辞了，跑到村里开启了养殖场。开养殖场也就算了，养的东西奇怪也能够接受，只是这家伙后来居然养起了老鼠。“老弟，别怪村长发火，他也是为了大家考虑，而且你也和我们保证过，将那些老鼠处理掉，可这都一个多月了，你怎么还在养呢？”书记也是一脸无奈的看着王仙，他和王仙是本家，而且别看他和王仙的年龄差了几乎三十岁，可王仙的辈分在村里却高的出奇。“村长，书记，在给我三天时间，就三天，三天后我保证将那些老鼠处理掉。我都养了这么长时间了，你们总不能让我血本无归吧？”王仙可怜巴巴的看着两人保证道。“你……”村长看着王仙的样子，更加气了，上次这小子也是这样跟他们保证的。“好了，老魏，就再给这小子三天时间，要是他不解决，我们在帮他解决，你看怎么样？”书记连忙劝说道。“你就惯着他吧。”村长怼了书记一句后，带着怒气直接离开了。“唉，让我怎么说你小子呀！记住，三天，只有三天，三天后不处理，我就帮你处理！”书记叹息了一声后，也离开了。目送两人离开后，王仙打开铁门，将电动三轮车开了进去，又将货物卸了以后，来到了休息的地方。坐在窗户前的沙发上，从兜里拿出了一快玉佩，轻轻摩擦着。这是一块龙凤玉佩，玉质很烂，布满各种杂质，而且边缘还破了几个豁口，属于丢在大街上都没有人要的那种。龙凤玉佩唯一值得收藏的地方估计也只有玉佩中间的那一点血色存在，让这块龙凤玉佩看起来有稍微有那么一点点价值。“两天，还有两天……”王仙望着窗外清晰的天空，嘴中呢喃道。两天的时间转眼就过去了，人们如同往常一样做着该做的事件，可是突然之间，一道不含任何情绪，如同机械合成的声音，毫无预兆的在所有人脑海之中骤然响起。“数据模板加载中……”“通讯模块加载中……”“论坛模块加载中……”“安全区域开始生成……”“野外副本开始生成……”“转职神殿开始生成……”“……”“生命转化开始！”一道道的声音在脑海之中响起。无数人开始慌了起来，他们不知道这声音从何而来，但看周围人的样子，显然所有人都听到了。
content_en:
On the street of a small village, a young man of about 20 years old was driving an electric tricycle filled with goods.The young man's name is Wang Xian, and he is one of the few college students in the village.After Wang Xian graduated from university, he stayed in the big city where he went to school and had a stable job. Both the salary and the working environment were excellent.Moreover, with his own efforts, Wang Xian also bought a house in that big city. Of course, it was just a down payment.He has a stable job and a house. In addition, Wang Xian's appearance and figure are both on the upper side. With the introduction of a friend, he also found his significant other.Under such conditions, Wang Xian's reputation in the village is naturally not low.After all, in the village, when people have nothing to do and chat, they always compare the children of different families with each other, and Wang Xian is exactly what people call ‘other people’s children’.However, this kind of thing changed a year ago. Wang Xian was no longer 'other people's child' in the eyes of the people, but a model that was taken out by everyone to teach their own children.All this happened because Wang Xian suddenly quit his stable job in a big city a year ago, sold the house with a down payment at a low price, and even broke up with his beautiful girlfriend.This was Wang Xian's own business, and no one said anything. As fellow villagers, they just felt sorry for Wang Xian.In their opinion, perhaps Wang Xian encountered some difficulty in the big city.However, this view has completely changed over time.They originally thought that Wang Xian would stay at home for a while and get back on his feet, but what Wang Xian did next shocked everyone, and they even suspected that Wang Xian was possessed by evil spirits.He stayed at home all day long with nothing to do, and there would often be roaring sounds coming from his home. People in the village could tell that this was the voice of Wang Xian's father.After going on like this for nearly ten months, Wang Xian finally stopped doing nothing. Instead, he rented a piece of land and opened a breeding farm.Originally, the breeding farm was nothing, and it was considered a normal job, although it was a bit tiring and dirty.However, what Wang Xian breeds is not the poultry or livestock they are familiar with, but all kinds of strange things, including cockroaches, earthworms, locusts, scorpions, centipedes and so on.What is most unacceptable to the villagers is that Wang Xian's breeding farm also raises a large number of rats.That's right, it's rats, one of the most hated creatures in rural areas.Well, everything raised is Wang Xian's own business, even if it's mice. Although the villagers have opinions, they just talk behind their backs. After all, Wang Xian's breeding farm has done a good job of sealing it off. A few months have passed, and no mice or other strange things have ever escaped from the breeding farm. More importantly, the breeding farm is not close to the village.However, farming is farming, and the people in the village have not seen any benefit from Wang Xian.Not only that, but he also sold the house his father bought in the city and used it all to buy food and feed. It is said that this made his father sick.Wang Xian drove a tricycle filled with goods through the village. After driving for five or six minutes, he came to a building surrounded by about three meters high walls and only an iron gate.At this moment, two middle-aged men stood in front of the iron gate.Seeing these two people, Wang Xian's expression changed slightly."Village Chief, Secretary, why are you two here?" Wang Xian got out of the car, quickly took out a box of cigarettes, and handed it to the two of them."Don't bring this up. How did you promise me last month? You raised those cockroaches, earthworms, centipedes, scorpions, etc., and I didn't say anything. After all, those things are considered medicinal materials, but why did you raise so many rats? Can you just raise this crap? What should you do if there is a plague?" The village chief looked at Wang Xian with an angry face, and there was a hint of hatred in his tone that iron could not be transformed into steel.

When Wang Xian was admitted to college, it was still a key university, and he received a reward from the town, which made him famous in Shiliba Village. But now this kid actually quit his job in the big city and ran to the village to open a breeding farm.It's okay to open a breeding farm, and it's acceptable to raise weird things, but this guy actually raised rats later."Brother, don't blame the village chief for getting angry. He is thinking about everyone, and you promised us to get rid of those mice. But it's been more than a month, why are you still raising them?" The secretary also looked at Wang Xian helplessly. He and Wang Xian were from the same family, and despite the almost thirty-year age difference between him and Wang Xian, Wang Xian's seniority was surprisingly high in the village."Village chief, secretary, give me three days, just three days. After three days, I promise to get rid of those rats. I have raised them for such a long time, you can't let me lose everything, can you?" Wang Xian looked at the two of them pitifully and promised."You..." The village chief looked at Wang Xian and became even more angry. This boy also promised them the same thing last time."Okay, Old Wei, just give this kid three more days. If he doesn't solve it, we'll help him solve it. What do you think?" the secretary quickly persuaded."Just spoil him." The village chief said something to the secretary and left angrily."Hey, let me tell you what to say, kid! Remember, three days, only three days. If you don't handle it after three days, I will handle it for you!" The secretary sighed and left.After watching the two people leave, Wang Xian opened the iron door, drove the electric tricycle in, unloaded the goods, and came to the resting place.Sitting on the sofa in front of the window, he took out a jade pendant from his pocket and rubbed it gently.This is a dragon and phoenix jade pendant. The quality of the jade is very bad, covered with various impurities, and there are several holes on the edge. It is the kind that no one would want if left on the street.The only thing worth collecting about the dragon and phoenix jade pendant is probably the little bit of blood in the middle of the jade pendant, which makes this dragon and phoenix jade pendant look a little bit valuable."Two days, two more days..." Wang Xian looked at the clear sky outside the window and murmured.Two days passed in the blink of an eye, and people were doing what they should do as usual, but suddenly, a voice without any emotion, like a mechanical synthesis, suddenly sounded in everyone's mind without warning."Data template is loading..." "Communication module is loading..." "Forum module is loading..." "Safe area starts to be generated..." "Wild copy starts to be generated..." "Job transfer temple starts to be generated..." "..." "Life transformation starts!" Voices sounded in my mind.Countless people started to panic. They didn't know where the sound came from, but looking at the people around them, it was obvious that everyone heard it.
